title: Parameterized and Streaming Algorithms for Euclidean Fair $k$-Center Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2609.06384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Motivated by the growing importance of fairness in machine learning, fair $k$-center clustering has attracted considerable research attention as a fundamental problem. In this problem, a dataset is partitioned into $m$ disjoint groups, and the objective is to select $k$ data points as centers, subject to upper bounds on the number of centers chosen from each group, aiming to minimize the maximum distance between any data point and its assigned center. Focusing on Euclidean spaces, which are ubiquitous in machine learning applications, we first develop a parameterized approximation algorithm for Euclidean fair $k$-center with an approximation ratio of $2.732$. By incorporating this algorithm as a post-processing stage into a one-pass streaming framework for large-scale data, we obtain an approximation ratio of $4.464$. translated_title: 欧几里得公平 k-中心聚类的参数化与流式算法
translated_abstract: 受机器学习中公平性日益重要的推动，公平 k-中心聚类作为一个基础问题引起了广泛的研究关注。在该问题中，数据集被划分为 m 个不相交的组，目标是在每组所选中心数量受上界约束的条件下，选取 k 个数据点作为中心，以最小化任意数据点与其分配中心之间的最大距离。聚焦于在机器学习应用中无处不在的欧几里得空间，我们首先为欧几里得公平 k-中心问题开发了一种近似比为 2.732 的参数化近似算法。通过将该算法作为后处理阶段并入面向大规模数据的单遍流式框架中，我们获得了 4.464 的近似比。在运行时间对 k 呈指数级的情况下，这两个近似比可分别进一步改进为 2.414 和 3.828。为确保……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对欧几里得公平 k-中心聚类问题，首次提出了近似比为 2.732 的参数化近似算法和近似比为 4.464 的单遍流式算法，并在运行时间对 k 呈指数级时将两者近似比分别提升至 2.414 和 3.828。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first parameterized approximation algorithm with ratio 2.732 and a one-pass streaming algorithm with ratio 4.464 for Euclidean fair k-center clustering, and further improves these ratios to 2.414 and 3.828 respectively at the cost of runtime exponential in k.
